### Observed differences

- Activity A02 was rare in the earlier window: it appeared in about 3 in 100 traces (6 of 200 traces; mean occurrences per trace 0.03) and never more than once within a trace. In the later window it appeared in about 12 in 100 traces (23 of 200; mean 0.115), again at most once per trace — an increase of about 8.5 percentage points in participation, with no within-trace repetition in either window. [OCC001]
- The size of this difference is unusual for random re-splits of the pooled traces: it exceeds about 199 of 200 reference comparisons. The earlier-window share, however, rests on only 6 traces, so the baseline proportion is weakly supported. [OCC001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. Only one indicator qualified, and with 0.44 items expected by chance across the 89 tested units, a single item is what an unchanged process typically produces; in addition, the earlier-window participation estimate rests on only 6 traces. [OCC001]
